results.content:
Everyday Americans have taken notice, and they are not pleased. The approval of President Trump and his administration’s policies is near historic lows. A July 2026 Pew Research Center poll found Trump’s overall approval at only 34 percent, while a CNN poll from the same month found that a record-high 73 percent of Americans said Trump has not paid enough attention to the nation’s most important problems.
